rows: Archive hosting, nightly backup and six-monthly restore testing

text.services.value:
The Supplier will host the Customer's document archive in its EU data centre. Every night the archive is backed up.

Every six months the Supplier will carry out a restore test to confirm that the archived documents can be recovered from backup.

Additional penetration testing and extra storage are available on request and are charged at the rates set out in section 2.
points: hosting of the customer's document archive in an EU data centre
a restore test every six months

unsupported_claims: the restore test is described as confirming that archived documents can be recovered from backup, which the notes do not state
penetration testing and extra storage are described as 'available on request', which the notes do not say; the notes only say they go in the fee table as extras
the reference to 'section 2' for the rates is not supported by the notes

text.services.value:
The Provider will carry out quarterly security patching of the Customer's application servers.

After each patching cycle, the Provider will deliver a change log and a short test report to the Customer.
points: quarterly security patching of the customer's application servers
a change log after each cycle
a short test report after each cycle

text.services.value: The service provider shall maintain the integration of the Customer's online shop with its payment and shipping providers. This includes updating the integration whenever those providers change their interfaces.
points: maintenance of the customer's online shop integration with its payment and shipping providers

text.services.value:
The Supplier will operate and monitor the Customer's warehouse management platform. Incidents affecting the platform are handled during business hours.

The Supplier will also send the Customer a monthly service report covering the services delivered in the preceding month.
points: operation and monitoring of the customer's warehouse management platform

unsupported_claims: The monthly service report covers the services delivered in the preceding month. The notes only say a monthly service report is sent, with no detail about its content or period.
